question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Iron is / most useful / than any / other metal.
solution:
The correct answer is **Most useful.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Most useful"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct usage is **"the most useful" **instead of **"most useful."**
 
• **We use "the most" for the superlative forms of lengthier adjectives and the majority of adverbs.**
 
 
• **Example: ***America is the most powerful country in the world. *
 
 

*​*The correct sentence is: Iron is the most useful than any other metal.​*​* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When referring to numbers, amounts, and degrees, we use the word **"most.**" 
 
• Most can be used with a noun or a pronoun.
 
 
• **Example:*** Most of his time is wasted on sleeping. *
